mapper.select: select distinct selection.device_satellite_id, selection.telemetry_code, device.type as device_satellite_type, device.code as device_satellite_code from processed_telemetry_filter_selection selection inner join device_satellite device on device.id = selection.device_satellite_id and device.is_deleted = 0 where selection.is_deleted = 0 and exists ( select rule.id from telemetry_parse_rule_config rule where rule.device_satellite_id = selection.device_satellite_id and rule.telemetry_code = selection.telemetry_code and rule.is_deleted = 0 ) order by selection.device_satellite_id, selection.telemetry_code

select selection.device_satellite_id, selection.telemetry_code, selection.selection_type, selection.target_id, rule_config.telemetry_name, device.type as device_satellite_type, device.code as device_satellite_code from processed_telemetry_filter_selection selection inner join device_satellite device on device.id = selection.device_satellite_id and device.is_deleted = 0
inner join ( select ranked.device_satellite_id, ranked.telemetry_code, ranked.telemetry_name from ( select r.device_satellite_id, r.telemetry_code, r.telemetry_name, row_number() over ( partition by r.device_satellite_id, r.telemetry_code order by case when r.table_index ~ '^[0-9]+$' then r.table_index::numeric end desc nulls last, r.id desc ) as code_order from telemetry_parse_rule_config r where r.is_deleted = 0 ) ranked where ranked.code_order = 1 ) rule_config on rule_config.device_satellite_id = selection.device_satellite_id and rule_config.telemetry_code = selection.telemetry_code where selection.is_deleted = 0 and selection.selection_type = #{selectionType} and selection.target_id = #{targetId} order by selection.device_satellite_id, selection.telemetry_code
select device_satellite_id, telemetry_code, selection_type, target_id from processed_telemetry_filter_selection where device_satellite_id = #{deviceSatelliteId} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: insert into processed_telemetry_filter_selection (device_satellite_id, telemetry_code, selection_type, target_id, is_deleted) values (#{deviceSatelliteId}, #{telemetryCode}, #{selectionType}, #{targetId}, 0) on conflict (selection_type, target_id, device_satellite_id, telemetry_code) do update set is_deleted = excluded.is_deleted, update_time = current_timestamp
mapper.delete:
